statement: The MovieLens affinity demo (5-node local formation) survives a CREATE TABLE that arrives while the run-20 operation-ledger self-move hold (or the run-22 quorum-spread hold) is engaged: provisioning admission absorbs the transient internally with a bounded wait-and-reevaluate loop while every cohort-blocking reason is a transient ledger-interlock reason, and the client receives the provisioned table instead of 'Unable to satisfy minimum routable provisioning cohort ... operation_ledger_self_move_in_flight' (run-24 head: the demo died at its first CREATE TABLE ~6s after formation, provisionable=0/required=2, all three targets deferred). Proven by a deterministic DT reproduction (guard-test scenario-harness, consecutive 3) and the interlock error message embedding the HELD ledger operation's partition id instead of the admitted operation's.

constraints.text: RESEARCH FIRST: map the existing provisioning-admission evaluation loop (sql-query-engine-provisioning-admission-methods.js — TRANSIENT_PROVISIONING_SHORTFALL_REASONS already classifies the 3 ledger reasons; run-22 recorded follow-up), any existing bounded-wait machinery in the provisioning path (provision-partition-waits tests suggest waits exist), and the interlock hold lifecycle (rebalance-coordinator-ledger-interlock-admission.js state.heldSelfMoveOperationId + tryClearHeldOperationLedgerSelfMove). REUSED vs EXTENDED vs NEW required in every finding. NO new caches; NO client-side (demo) retries — internal pacing must not rely on client fidelity; the wait must be bounded by an EXISTING budget (no raised timeouts, TEST-0021).

DT-FIRST: deterministic reproduction (unit-level provisioning admission with a held ledger self-move; RED on head = client-visible cohort failure while all blocking reasons are transient) BEFORE src changes; dt:prove red-on-revert; scenario-harness runner x3 for closure.

Design + implementation verified by adversarial subagents BEFORE commit. Key attack surfaces: livelock (what if the hold NEVER clears — the wait must be bounded and then fail honestly with the same typed error), starvation fairness across concurrent CREATEs, whether waiting inside admission blocks an event-loop lane (the run-23 lane head-of-line P2 is adjacent), and whether the wait belongs in the engine admission loop vs the coordinator gate.

One defect class: the transient-hold fail-fast. The mislabeled interlock message (admitted op partition embedded instead of the held ledger op) rides along as an honest-logging fix. Do NOT touch the hold semantics themselves (run-20/22 fixes are validated); do NOT add exemptions for user-table ADDs.
